headline: Duran Sparks A Thrilling Late Rally To Slay The Royals
morning_brew: Now that is how you fight back on the road. I been sayin' it all year, this lineup has the talent to make noise if they just play smart. Jarren Duran came up huge last night in Kansas City, launching an opposite field two-run homer in the seventh inning to rally the local nine to a four to three victory. Connelly Early gave us a quality start, grinding through six and a third innings to earn the win. Willson Contreras stayed absolutely locked in at the plate with three hits. It is great to see these guys showing some real grit and stringing some wins together.

The bullpen did exactly what they were supposed to do to lock this one down. Greg Weissert and Jovani Moran did the heavy lifting in relief before Aroldis Chapman came in to shut the door in the ninth for the save. We ended up with eleven hits on the night, and even with one error, we played clean enough baseball to secure the win. If the pitching can keep giving us these kinds of opportunities, this team might actually start climbing out of the cellar.

Over in Foxborough, wide receiver Kyle Williams is reportedly making some major changes to his routine this summer. We need all the help we can get on the outside, so if he can take his game to the next level, that is a massive win for Drake Maye and this offense. Meanwhile, the offseason rumors are swirling around the Garden with mock drafts and asset rankings taking over the airwaves. Both of our winter teams have a long road ahead to rebuild their rosters, and the front offices better be working the phones daily.
